text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "URA Finals" came to a close amidst 
tremendous fanfare. And then—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Astonishing! Joyous! A blessing! To think 
that your Umamusume would actually take 
first place!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm! Seeing that look of satisfaction on 
your face makes hosting it all worthwhile!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However, you are not the only one with a 
satisfied expression.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume watching in the stands had 
sparkling eyes, yearning to run in a race 
like this.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The Trainers tremble with excitement as 
well, eager to seize this newly forged 
honor. And then...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
This excitement has far exceeded all 
imagination! Voices are already clamoring 
in anticipation for the next event!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
All of this is thanks to you raising such 
a once-in-a-generation star Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I am truly glad we could hold this grand 
event. From the bottom of my heart... 
thank you!!!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Please continue doing your utmost to 
ensure our horse girls shine for all 
eternity!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that's enough chatting. Go on 
over to your Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The best partner is surely waiting for 
you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I left the racecourse together with <chrname>, who 
had been waiting for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back—we reminisced about our 
journey so far, our conversation 
blossoming with fond memories.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And facing the unseen stages and rivals 
that await us ahead— we promised to do our 
best together, no matter what."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, the next day—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock knock!)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Reporting for duty! Trainer <username>, pardon the 
intrusion while you're working!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm! Surprised, weren't you! Very 
good, excellent reaction!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Alright, shall we be on our way then!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! You need not understand! Just 
follow my lead!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: —Take this!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Out of the blue, Chairwoman Akikawa threw 
a burlap sack over me! I can't see a 
thing...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Over here! I'll take your hand, so don't 
worry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With no idea where I'm even walking, I'm 
led along by Chairwoman Akikawa by the 
hand...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Alright, we're here!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Are you mentally prepared?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: One... two... Three!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Once again... Congratulations on becoming 
the Finals Champion!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"To celebrate this great success, I have 
prepared a modest banquet!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Greetings! Here is my special Carrot 
Hamburg Steak DX! Don't be shy, take it!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The Chairwoman has been enthusiastically 
preparing since this morning, after all.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Meticulous, indeed! If we count selecting 
the materials, it started two months ago!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...The attention to detail is incredible.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>, congratulations so very much! 
That was a run so captivating, I couldn't 
take my eyes off it...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
However, we won't lose next time. Isn't 
that right, Meek?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Rivals forever. ...Always.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Commending each other's efforts and 
reminiscing over memories, the lively 
celebration continued on...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Commending each other's efforts and 
reminiscing over memories, the lively 
celebration continued on...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Utterly satisfied! Both my heart and my 
belly are completely full!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Perhaps I got a bit too eager and 
overprepared.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Still, it should be just right for growing 
Umamusume! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then! There is something I have 
long wished to give you."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Take this folding fan!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...This is the folding fan I inherited 
from the previous chairwoman. It is, so to 
speak, the embodiment of my resolve."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Today! To you, who are worthy of being 
entrusted with the future of Umamusume! I 
bestow this folding fan!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I believe there is no one more 
suited for this than you! Trainer <username>!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Proof! Those eyes, that brilliance, what a 
splendid look on your face! I knew my 
assessment wasn't wrong after all!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Keep taking good care of the Umamusume 
from now on, too, Trainer <username>!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tucking the folding fan safely inside our 
robes, <chrname> and I vowed to keep answering 
Chairwoman Akikawa's burning passion!
